roadmap.title: Run the campaign on wood engines
roadmap.description: Play in Relaxed Mode. For the Wood engine achievement, research only wood engines from the first minute and leave every other engine type untouched. Complete the story deliveries at the Starter Island's Weather Station and the Snow Island's Research Facility, taking side jobs whenever you need money or scrap. Landing gear, wings, cockpits, fuel tanks, fuselage, and balloons are all unrestricted.

roadmap.title: Campaign side unlocks before the missions run out
roadmap.description: While delivery contracts are still active, complete the Desert Island ground run that combines Cargo truck, Wingless, and Airship, and finish two active missions on a single landing for Two Birds, One Flight. These unlocks need an active delivery, so plan them before the mission list runs out.

roadmap.title: Finish the campaign with wood engines
roadmap.description: Complete the Desert Island story through the Explosion Site and the Waste Storage and deliver the Radioactive Waste with a wood-engine aircraft. Campaign and Wood engine unlock together on that delivery; afterwards every engine type can be researched freely.

roadmap.title: Clean up every remaining mission
roadmap.description: Complete all delivery contracts, including the hidden airports, the prison island, the seaport, and the four helipad ships. Helipad contracts register only after you land on the ship and collect the reward.

roadmap.title: Post-campaign speed and height builds
roadmap.description: With the campaign finished and all parts available, build a rocket plane for Speed 1, Speed 2, and Speed 3, then a balloon stack for Edge of space.

achievements.description: Make a delivery without leaving the ground
achievements.summary: Complete a delivery without ever leaving the ground.

guide.context: The achievement is missable, so complete it during the campaign while delivery contracts remain. The Desert Island is the easiest place because its terrain is mostly flat. The same run can also unlock Wingless and Airship: the ground vehicle has no main wings or tailwings and its top speed stays under 50. One completed delivery is enough; you do not need to finish the full mission chain.

steps.text: Build a wide ground vehicle. Fit about 8 @item{Wood Engines} and oversized @item{Retractable Gears} so the body clears the terrain. Add stacked cockpits, side fuselage parts, and several fuel tanks.
steps.note: The vehicle reaches roughly 40 speed empty and 30 with the Titanium on board.

steps.text: Load @item{Titanium} at the @loc{Mine} on the @loc{Desert Island}.
Drive on the ground from the @loc{Mine} to the @loc{Waste Storage}. Follow the flat route that passes the two lakes and avoid the large hills that stall a wood-engine vehicle.
steps.note: Small bumps and hops along the way do not count as leaving the ground.

steps.text: Hand over the Titanium at the @loc{Waste Storage}; the achievement unlocks as the delivery completes.

guide.context: The campaign runs through the Weather Station on the Starter Island, the Research Facility on the Snow Island, and the Explosion Site and Waste Storage on the Desert Island. Extra deliveries along the way are normally needed to pay for stronger aircraft. If the waste task does not appear after the Explosion Site's water delivery, land at the Waste Storage to trigger its pending request first.

steps.text: Complete the main-story deliveries at the @loc{Weather Station} on the @loc{Starter Island} and the @loc{Research Facility} on the @loc{Snow Island}.
steps.note: Side deliveries provide the money and scrap needed for the heavier Desert Island cargo.

steps.text: On the @loc{Desert Island}, complete the water delivery to the @loc{Explosion Site}.
Land at the @loc{Waste Storage} and complete its request by delivering 1 @item{Titanium} and 1 @item{Lead}.
Load the @item{Radioactive Waste} at the @loc{Explosion Site} and deliver it to the @loc{Waste Storage}; a short cutscene and a title screen play, and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Finish the campaign with wood engines only
achievements.estTime: the full campaign run with wood engines only
achievements.summary: Complete the main campaign using only @item{Wood Engines} and researching no other engine type.

guide.context: The achievement is missable: researching even one engine type other than the @item{Wood Engine} permanently voids it for that save, so unlock no other engines until the campaign is finished. Relaxed Mode is permitted and makes the delivery missions easier because it removes time limits and fragile cargo. Only the main campaign is required, so optional missions can be skipped.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Relaxed Mode} for the run. Research only the @item{Wood Engine} and leave every other engine type unresearched.
steps.note: Wings, cockpits, fuel tanks, landing gear, fuselage, and balloons can all be upgraded freely.

steps.text: Build your campaign aircraft from @item{Wood Engines}. Place engines in a line behind one another to cut drag, and mount @item{Balloons} inside the body so heavy cargo can be lifted at low speed.
steps.note: Keep spinning propellers clear of other parts: overlapping blades break and lose thrust. Doubling engines with the rear one inverted works while the blades clip nothing. The final 750-cargo delivery is achievable with wood engines and balloons.

steps.text: Complete the campaign by handing the @item{Radioactive Waste} over at the @loc{Waste Storage}; the achievement unlocks together with Campaign.
After the achievement unlocks, research every remaining engine type and rebuild freely for the cleanup missions.

achievements.description: Complete a mission with a plane that has no wings
achievements.summary: Complete a delivery with an aircraft that has no @item{main wings} and no @item{tailwings}.

guide.context: The achievement is missable, so finish it during the campaign while deliveries remain. Two builds qualify: the wingless ground vehicle used for Cargo truck, or a balloon-and-helicopter hybrid that can also unlock Airship.

steps.text: Build a vehicle with no @item{main wings} and no @item{tailwings}; the ground vehicle from Cargo truck already qualifies because it uses neither.

If you prefer flying, build the balloon hybrid: remove the wings and mount many @item{Balloons} on the sides. Add two upward-pointing @item{Engines} to compensate for the fuel weight lost during the trip, and carry several @item{Fuel Tanks} inside the fuselage.
steps.note: The fuel tanks are necessary because the hybrid flies slowly and the delivery takes a long time.

steps.text: Complete any active delivery with the wingless vehicle; driving the whole ground route also completes Cargo truck, and the balloon hybrid also completes Airship.

achievements.description: Complete 2 missions using only a single takeoff and landing.
achievements.summary: Complete two delivery missions with a single takeoff and landing.

guide.context: A mission is one request, such as an island's order to deliver fish, and it completes only when its last item is handed over, so the final items of both orders must be delivered on the same landing. Earlier partial deliveries spread over several flights do not break the achievement. The Hermit's fish-and-crab orders are the easiest pair to combine; the SOS camp and the Water Station's chemical orders work the same way. The achievement is missable, so do it while active missions remain.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Hermit}, the small island between the @loc{Snow Island} and the @loc{Desert Island}, and accept its two orders for fish and crabs.
steps.note: The two orders count as separate missions even though they are delivered to the same island.

steps.text: Deliver fish and crabs over as many flights as you like, but leave the last small batch of each undelivered.
steps.note: For example, deliver 3 fish and 3 crabs, then another 3 and 3, and save the final 2 fish and 2 crabs for the last landing.

steps.text: On the last flight, land once at the @loc{Hermit} and hand over the remaining fish and the remaining crabs together; the achievement unlocks on that landing.

achievements.description: Complete every mission in the campaign
achievements.summary: Complete every delivery mission in the campaign, not just the main story.

guide.context: Finished campaigns often still leave the hidden locations and ship contracts open. If the achievement does not unlock, the usual cause is a contract that was accepted but never finished, so re-check each location.

steps.text: After finishing the campaign, land at every airport on the @loc{Starter Island}, the @loc{Snow Island}, and the @loc{Desert Island} and accept any missions you have not completed.
steps.note: Landing is required for a mission to appear; hovering over an airport marker is not enough.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{prison island} mission northeast of the @loc{Starter Island} and the @loc{seaport} contracts.

Complete the hidden-location missions: the two non-story airports on the @loc{Starter Island}, the @loc{wrecked ship} in the south, the @loc{SOS camp} on the @loc{Snow Island}, and the @loc{Hermit} between the Snow and Desert Islands.

Complete the four ship missions: @loc{WaveRider} west of the @loc{Snow Island}, @loc{IronSail} north of the @loc{Snow Island}, @loc{DawnBreaker} east of the @loc{Snow Island}, and @loc{OilTanker} west of the @loc{Desert Island}.
steps.note: Hover beside each ship to hand over the cargo, then touch down on its deck and pick up your payment. The contract registers only once the reward has been collected.

steps.text: If the achievement still does not unlock, hover over every airport on the map to find an unfinished request, then visit and land at each location again; the achievement unlocks as soon as the last contract registers.

achievements.description: Complete a mission without exceeding a speed of 50 between takeoff and landing
achievements.summary: Complete a delivery without exceeding a speed of 50 between takeoff and landing.

guide.context: The achievement is missable, so complete it during the campaign while deliveries remain. No airship is required: the wide wood-engine ground vehicle from Cargo truck stays under the limit, and the same delivery can also unlock Cargo truck and Wingless. The balloon-and-helicopter hybrid from Wingless works as an alternative.

steps.text: Build the ground vehicle from Cargo truck, or the balloon-and-helicopter hybrid from Wingless.
Complete one delivery without letting the speed readout go above 50 for the whole run.
steps.note: The ground vehicle's top speed of about 40 empty and 30 loaded keeps the run safely under the limit. The achievement unlocks when the delivery completes.

achievements.estTime: about 10 min in a rocket plane

guide.context: Each of the three speed achievements unlocks during one full-throttle flight because the speed readout keeps climbing past every threshold. The @item{Rocket Engine} must be researched first; scrap and circuits for research come from world pickups and mission rewards. A 6-7-rocket plane can pass 4000 speed, and 3 stacked rocket engines also work.

steps.text: Research the @item{Rocket Engine}. Build a minimal speed plane: an elongated cockpit, one @item{Retractable Landing Gear}, and several rocket engines at the rear.
steps.note: Pack large external fuel tanks inside the cockpit and spend any remaining money on external fuel tanks.

steps.text: After takeoff, ease into a gentle climb, raise the gear, and open the throttle fully.
Keep accelerating until the speed readout passes 500; the achievement unlocks, and continuing the same flight unlocks Speed 2 and Speed 3 as well.

achievements.estTime: about 10 min in a rocket plane

guide.context: The same rocket build used for Speed 1 reaches this threshold moments after 500 speed, so no extra flight is needed. If the plane stalls before the readout reaches 1000, add more rocket engines or carry more fuel tanks so the burn lasts longer.

steps.text: Build the same rocket plane used for Speed 1: an elongated cockpit, one @item{Retractable Landing Gear}, several rear rocket engines, and as many external fuel tanks as it can carry.
After takeoff, climb gently, raise the gear, and push the throttle to maximum.
Keep accelerating until the speed readout passes 1000; the achievement unlocks on the same flight that earns Speed 1.

achievements.estTime: about 15 min in a rocket plane

guide.context: The same full-throttle flight unlocks Speed 1 and Speed 2 on the way, so the whole set can be earned in one launch. A 6-7-rocket plane can pass 4000 speed, well above this threshold.

steps.text: Research the @item{Rocket Engine}, then build the fastest plane you can: an elongated cockpit, minimal landing gear, a stack of rear rocket engines, and fuel tanks filling the remaining space.
After takeoff, level into a shallow climb, retract the gear, and open the throttle all the way without letting the plane dive.
Keep accelerating until the speed readout passes 3000; the achievement unlocks and completes the speed set.

guide.context: Balloons are expensive; a full stack costs about 40,000 coins. The craft climbs on its own after takeoff, so the achievement needs no input beyond waiting. The climb takes roughly two minutes.

steps.text: Build a single fuselage and attach as many @item{Balloons} as you can afford.
Take off and let the aircraft climb without any further input.
Wait until the altitude reaches 10,000; the achievement unlocks automatically.
steps.note: To confirm the climb, hold right-click to swing the camera underneath the craft; the region label and the altitude figure appear below it.
